say:0:1013115001:0.text: Unbelievable... Perhaps he just doesn't want to sell it?
say:0:1013115001:0.source_cn: 这个世界上竟然有讲不下来的价钱……他该不会是不想卖吧？

say:1:1013115002:0.text: Well... You can't win them all.
say:1:1013115002:0.source_cn: ……常言道，女神赐给人口齿，却未必同时赐下歌喉与辩才。

say:2:1013115003:0.text: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.
say:2:1013115003:0.source_cn: 没关系，这实在没办法。我们继续追踪魔偶的气息前进吧。
say:2:1013115003:0.male: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.
say:2:1013115003:0.female: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.
